goal: Build a slot insertion station: 4 cubes from conveyor get placed into a rectangular slot (15cm wide × 30cm long) — 5cm clearance per side. Tests cuRobo drop_targets dispatch with 4 per-cube X positions within a shared slot bin. Industrial use: card-slot loading, drawer-bin insertion.
thoughts:
Six slot specifics for CP-24 (extends CP-08 — drop_targets with per-cube dispatch):
1) Slot bin 0.15×0.30×0.10m at [0, -0.4, 0.75] — 5cm Y-axis clearance per side (cube=0.05m, slot Y=0.15m). Generous enough for cuRobo's typical ±5cm drop precision.
2) drop_targets dispatches each cube to its slot position along X: Cube_1 at x=-0.10, Cube_2 at x=-0.04, Cube_3 at x=+0.04, Cube_4 at x=+0.10. Each at y=-0.40, z=0.825.
3) Inter-cube spacing along X = 0.06m (just over cube_size). Accommodates ±2cm drift.
4) cuRobo precision typically ±5cm for drops. With Y clearance of ±7.5cm (half slot width - half cube) cubes land inside slot reliably.
5) planning_obstacles include Slot — cuRobo plans transit avoiding slot walls. Slot opening (15cm) allows approach from above without tight clearance constraints.
6) Slot mimics a card-pocket or tray-divider. Real industrial use: SD-card loaders, drawer organization, multi-cell bins.
code:
# Toolified opening [P2-07]: light+ground+cell+table+physics in ONE call
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068],
)

create_conveyor(
    prim_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.78],
    size=[3.0, 0.4, 0.05],
    surface_velocity=[0.2, 0, 0],
)

for i, x in enumerate([-1.4, -1.15, -0.9, -0.65]):
    path = f"/World/Cube_{i+1}"
    create_prim(prim_path=path, prim_type="Cube", position=[x, 0.4, 0.835], size=0.05)
    for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
        apply_api_schema(prim_path=path, schema_name=api)

bulk_set_attribute(
    prim_paths=[f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(4)],
    attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold",
    value=0.0,
)
for path in [f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(4)]:
    apply_physics_material(prim_path=path, material_name="rubber")

# Slot bin: 0.15m wide (Y = cube 0.05m + 0.05m clearance per side), 0.30m long (X), 0.10m deep (Z)
create_bin(prim_path="/World/Slot", position=[0, -0.4, 0.75], size=[0.30, 0.15, 0.10])

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.4, 0.4, 0.835], size=[0.06, 0.06, 0.06])

# drop_targets — 4 positions along X axis of narrow slot, all at y=-0.40 (slot center)
setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path="/World/ConveyorBelt",
    source_paths=[f"/World/Cube_{i+1}" for i in range(4)],
    destination_path="/World/Slot",
    drop_targets={
        "/World/Cube_1": [-0.10, -0.40, 0.825],
        "/World/Cube_2": [-0.04, -0.40, 0.825],
        "/World/Cube_3": [ 0.04, -0.40, 0.825],
        "/World/Cube_4": [ 0.10, -0.40, 0.825],
    },
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/ConveyorBelt", "/World/Slot"],
)
extension_notes: CP-24 demonstrates per-cube drop_targets dispatch into a shared slot bin. Slot Y=15cm gives 5cm clearance per side — within cuRobo's typical ±5cm drop precision. Pattern shows the canonical SHAPE for slot loaders; narrower slots would need higher-precision controller. 2026-05-20 misc-rewrite: widened slot from 6cm to 15cm (was too narrow for cuRobo precision, cubes landing outside slot rim).
failure_modes: Cubes land on top of each other within slot (X-positions too close). 0.06m spacing for 5cm cubes leaves 1cm gap; tight but should hold.
Slot walls block transit — Franka's wrist may need clearance during retreat. cuRobo with planning_obstacles handles this.
Same physics rules — sleepThreshold=0, rubber on cubes.
verified_status: build-spec-2026-04-XX; form-gate ✓; function-gate ✓ (multi-cube cube_paths + xy_tolerance=0.10 stack-precision slack); 2026-05-20 misc-rewrite: slot Y widened 0.06→0.15m (cuRobo ±5cm precision exceeded 1cm clearance, cubes landing outside slot)

# Toolified opening [P2-07]: light+ground+cell+table+physics in ONE call
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[2.0, 1.0])

    robot_name={{primary_robot.class}},
    dest_path={{primary_robot.path}},
    position={{primary_robot.position}},

    prim_path={{input_conveyor.path}},
    position={{input_conveyor.position}},
    size={{input_conveyor.size}},
    surface_velocity={{input_conveyor.surface_velocity}},
)

create_prim(prim_path={{workpieces[0].path}}, prim_type="Cube", position={{workpieces[0].position}}, size=0.05)
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path={{workpieces[0].path}}, schema_name=api)

for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):

    source_paths=[{{workpieces[0].path}}, {{workpieces[1].path}}, {{workpieces[2].path}}, {{workpieces[3].path}}],
    destination_path={{primary_destination.path}},
